posts.text:
Technology's effect on jobs changes over time

In the First Industrial Revolution, handweaving had a "Golden Age" for 20 years because early machines made cheap yarn, which drove up demand for weavers. Then the powerloom came along, and handweavers lost their jobs and became the vanguard for Luddism
